messages:
Nina (partnerships): Quick sync: NorthCloud wants a private offer that bundles Reserved Credits + HW voucher. We need a clean pricing/renewal flow and ops playbook. Anyone object to vouchers instead of marketplace SKUs?
Raj - Marketplace: Vouchers are easier for HW because marketplaces hate non-consumable SKUs. Proposal: Put compute on-marketplace as `Reserved Compute Credits` SKU, and HW as a redeemable voucher code we deliver post-accept.
Lena (finance): Need clarity on revenue recognition: marketplace commit = deferred rev; voucher redemption = service delivery. If vouchers can be deferred >90d we need different treatment. Also, how do discounts stack with existing seat/usage discounts?
Omar - HW PM: From hardware ops: vouchers must include serialized redemption flow (partner portal) and an expiry. Prefer 9-month redemption window. Also: include a clause for returns / defective HW credits.
Claire (legal): Two flags: 1) ensure voucher non-transferability and clear tax treatment line 2) renewal opt-in vs auto-renew. If we do tiered renewal discounts, contract must specify lookback period and true-up methodology. I'll draft.
Raj - Marketplace: Proposed renewal mechanism: quarterly usage true-up, with rebate applied as account-level credit if they hit X% over baseline. Renewal bands: <90% no discount, 90-110% base discount, >110% growth kicker. (This isn't the same as commit skirt used elsewhere.)
Nina (partnerships): Love the quarterly true-up. Can we keep renewal increments small so sales can sell? e.g., 3% incremental discount per 10% uplift rather than big jumps.
Lena (finance): Also propose a minimum consumption trigger to avoid huge carryover liabilities: if actuals < 50% of commit, we claw back 50% of unused credits as future credit only (not cash).
Omar - HW PM: We'd prefer a small SI enablement credit for install/config so partner actually deploys hardware. Suggest 20% of HW voucher released after completion of deployment checklist.
Claire (legal): Note on marketplaces: AWS private offers require SKU visibility and mapping. For vouchers delivered outside marketplace, ensure offer docs include redemption flow and that acceptance within marketplace is separate.
MarketplaceBot: FYI: AWS Private Offers must reference valid AWS Marketplace product codes. See https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/private-offers/
Raj - Marketplace: Draft SKU example for ops team: `{"ReservedComputeCredits": "redwood-reserved-v1", "SupportAddon": "redwood-support-std"}`. We'll keep that mapping internal.
Nina (partnerships): Action list: @Claire draft private-offer + voucher clause by Tue; @Lena give accounting impact notes and sample P&L impact; @Raj produce SKU mapping + sample invoice; @Omar finalize HW redemption flow and checklist. I'll schedule 30m follow-up Wed 11am.
Lena (finance): One more ask: provide a sample customer invoice/run-rate table so FP&A can model different renewal scenarios.
Omar - HW PM: Will add deployment milestone hooks for SI credit disbursement.
Claire (legal): I'll include a recommended auto-accept window and consumer-protection language.
Nina (partnerships): Great, thanks team. Keep comms in the partnership folder and tag updates. :rocket:
